featured_reviews.name: Natasha Mohdali
featured_reviews.review_text:
If I could give 10 ⭐️, I would! Mr. Nadeem is extremely professional and clearly takes great passion and pride in his work. From the very beginning, he was transparent with pricing, which I really appreciated.

It was my first time ordering traditional Indian clothing for a wedding (travelled all the way from Malaysia), and I wanted something versatile enough to wear again for other occasions. Mr. Nadeem gave excellent advice and delivered beautiful work in just two days. I even still have leftover fabric, which says a lot about how thoughtfully he cuts and plans the cloth. Truly proves what he says “if every tailor cut fabric with their brain…” 🤣🤣🤣

Highly recommended for anyone looking for honest pricing, quality craftsmanship, and beautifully tailored traditional wear.

featured_reviews.name: Suman Mishra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I cannot express how grateful I am to Mr. Nadeem Nikhaar Ji. He is truly a lifesaver.
My outfits had been completely ruined by another tailor, and with a wedding only two weeks away, I was in a panic. Every other tailor I approached refused to take up the urgent alterations. But Mr. Nadeem Ji not only agreed to help—he took on the challenge with confidence, kindness, and absolute professionalism.
The results were beyond anything I expected. Not only were the alterations done perfectly, but he also stitched a brand-new suit for me that fits like a dream. His craftsmanship, attention to detail, and dedication to delivering quality work—especially under time pressure—are exceptional.
It’s rare to find someone so skilled, dependable, and genuinely committed to helping clients. I am extremely impressed and deeply thankful.
Highly, highly recommended. If you want impeccable tailoring and someone who truly cares about his work, go to Mr. Nadeem Nikhaar Ji. He has earned my trust for life.

featured_reviews.name: Reyna Gopal
featured_reviews.review_text:
All I can say is WOW. I found Mr Nadeem via Google Maps and I was led to one of the best tailors I’ve encountered yet. We came in with a bunch of fabrics and Mr Nadeem and his an amazing team brought these stunning outfits to life within 72 hours.

Beautiful craftsmanship with minimal adjustments. He was very transparent with the pricing from the get-go, which we truly appreciated. So if you’re looking for good quality outfits and modern designs, you gotta be prepared to pay. And quite frankly, it’s worth every rupee.

Mr Nadeem made me look the most beautiful I’ve ever felt and I couldn’t thank him enough. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!

featured_reviews.name: Mahera Husain
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was very lucky to have found Mr. Nadeem from Nikhaar Creations.
He was able to make a perfect blouse within a day. I was very pleasantly surprised that the fitting, style and finishing was perfect in the first go. Definitely recommended, especially for their quick professional, service.

featured_reviews.name: sakshi dixit
featured_reviews.review_text:
I walked in with just my thoughts and ideas, and Nadeem brought them to life exactly the way I had imagined—if not better. Every detail was understood so patiently and translated beautifully into the final outfit. The stitching, the fit, the finish—everything was flawless.
Beyond the talent, he is an extremely sweet, calm, and patient designer who genuinely listens to what the customer wants. The entire experience felt personal, comfortable, and satisfying. Beautiful service, beautiful clothes, and a designer who truly cares about his craft. Highly recommended. 😊

featured_reviews.name: Pavitra Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: Nikhar creation is a hidden gem .thanks to my sister who discovered him  most of our family wedding collection  blouse kurtas fitting is from him . Nikhar creation became my saviour for last minute blouse done so perfectly n on time. This is my go to place now .

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
Edit Review: June 28 2025

I’d written a review on them 2 months prior seeing superior work on Indian kurtas. Still feel the same that they go very good job at Indian wear, stitched about 6-7 kurtas in less than 2 months all perfect! However, few of my formal tops because have been very badly handled and the finishing piece wasn’t even close to the image I’ve shared. Of course 2-3 tops were made v well, which I did acknowledge too.

But it’s  only heart wrenching that when you put out your soul into buying fabrics they are spoilt and spoilt big time, without any sign of remorse!
When  I started sending images of how my tops were completely out of shape and size my messages were blocked and still not replied to (been over 5 -6 days) if someone claims to be true designer, taking basic ownership as a professional is crucial instead of giving lame excuses of fabric being stretchy etc. We consider designers for a reason, that they would deliver what we seek.  For a basic black skirt, I simply asked for elastic and no hooks on the waist , I got exactly the opposite two hoops and zero elastic, with the skirt almost hanging below my belly button, inspite of giving my measurements properly just 2-3 days before delivery. I generally would never write a bad review but not accepting mistakes and blocking my texts and not responding is very very disappointing and unprofessional

featured_reviews.name: Marina Nicole Czarnecki
featured_reviews.review_text: Awesome place!! Came to him and he made custom blouses for me and my friends for a wedding in 1 day. Brought him my saree and he found material for a perfect blouse match. And he is so kind to talk to. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Saloni Garg
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been a regular customer at this store for a couple of years now — their clothing collection is genuinely good, and I’ve often shopped for bills above ₹15,000 each time. However, my experience with their bags was very disappointing — I had to return almost all of them because the threads came off within an hour of use.

What truly left a bad impression, though, was the attitude of the owner, Ranjana. Despite being a loyal and high-value customer, I’ve often felt ignored and treated unequally. Just last week, I bought items worth ₹12,000, and again today, I shopped for another ₹12,000 — yet, during my visit, I noticed she was giving Diwali gifts to others who spent much less, but not to me. Even the sales staff suggested it, but she refused slyly.

It’s not about the gift, but about the gesture and respect towards regular customers. Such partial behaviour really puts one off and makes you feel small. Unfortunately, this experience has changed my perception of the store, and I’ll be visiting and recommending it much less going forward.

featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely loved shopping at the Khar branch! The collection of ethnic wear is beautiful — elegant, stylish, and surprisingly comfortable to wear for long hours. featured_reviews.name: Allison Hughes
featured_reviews.review_text:

I worked with Anjum, who is incredibly knowledgeable and has a really good eye for what works. She helped me pick out a stunning Anarkali for an upcoming wedding, as well as a saree, a suit, and several casual pieces, all of which are gorgeous. The tailoring is impeccable, and Anjum’s professional approach and great service made the whole experience seamless. It was well worth the trip from the States to see the collection in person.

featured_reviews.name: Sarina Naik

She went above and beyond to even have a pocket square made for my husband of my saree material! Will always visit her when we come to Mumbai!

featured_reviews.name: Saloni Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I will be filing a complaint directly with Biba corporate because their exchange and return policy is completely unreasonable. I made a purchase worth 30k, and out of all the items, one suit didn’t fit well. Despite having the tags intact and being way under 15 days, I was forced to make an “exchange” instead of being offered a return. It seems Biba no longer values brand loyalty, and their return policy is unclear.

When I raised this with the store, the manager’s boss got on the phone and wouldn’t even let me explain my issue. Instead, she claimed that nowhere in the store is “return” mentioned. If that’s the case, then stop misleading customers—remove the signage entirely. If your store doesn’t offer returns, be upfront about it. Don’t take customers for a ride.

While the lady in the showroom agreed for the exchange, she was quite rude while giving the new piece and asked me to check thoroughly this time and mentioned another exchange won't be possible. Ridiculously rude - it's understandable that there can be defects. But as a customer I was inconveniencd at having to make a trip again to exchange.
